title: DeviceLink
description: State of the serial link to the ESP32 as seen by the bridge. Published on device.status, retained, on every change and every 5 seconds, and returned inside GET /sensors. ok means frames and acks flow, degraded means acks are timing out, down means no frame for 15 seconds, the port is closed or the protocol major differs.

device_id.description: Device identifier from the last hello, null before the first hello.

reason.description: Why the link is not ok, null when ok.

fw_version.description: Firmware version from the last hello, null before the first hello.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version from the last hello, null before the first hello.

uptime_ms.description: Device uptime from the latest hello or sensor_report, milliseconds, null before the first frame. A decrease means the device rebooted.

last_seen_at.description: Receipt time of the last uplink frame on the Pi clock, ISO 8601 UTC, null when none since bridge start.

last_error.description: Most recent error message from the device, null when none since the last hello.

LinkReason.title: LinkReason
LinkReason.description: no_hello means frames arrive but no hello yet, ack_timeouts means 2 or more consecutive commands timed out, silent means no uplink frame for 15 seconds, port_closed means the serial port is missing or failed, protocol_mismatch means the device protocol major differs from the contract major.

LinkError.title: LinkError
LinkError.description: Last error frame received from the device.

received_at.description: Receipt time on the Pi clock, ISO 8601 UTC.
